text_block_list.text:
We spent the entire day at the hospital 
putting <chrname> through a detailed examination.

As a result, no specific injuries were 
found. Her disordered stride after 
returning to Japan was apparently caused 
by sheer fatigue.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...! Trainer <username>!

As I made my way to the hospital waiting 
room, a familiar figure came rushing in.

"I had informed Mei Satake that I was 
getting examined today. I intended to call 
and report to her after leaving the 
hospital, but..."
choice_data_list: Did you come all this way for me?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, yeah. I wanted to ask you 
directly."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: How was it, <chrname>?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Good work, Satake.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
As per your instructions, I have compiled 
a list of the medical checkup statuses for 
each Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you. I'm sorry.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
—After returning to Japan, five Umamusume 
showed abnormalities in their running.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Of those, three Umamusume visited the 
infirmary and were examined at a hospital.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
In addition, while there were no issues in 
training, six Umamusume have shown a drop 
in condition since their last race...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
At the moment, everyone, including <chrname>, is on 
the road to recovery... but.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Talk about a complete lack of follow-up.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Based on past experience, I should have 
seen the possibility. ...I could have 
prevented this.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
In a situation where a level head was 
crucial, the one who failed to avoid that 
risk —...was me.
(*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...From Yayoi, huh. Ha ha. Did she hear 
about that matter already?

text_block_list.name: URA Director
text_block_list.text:
"Satake-kun. Am I right in assuming you'll 
continue focusing on Tracen Academy's 
overseas expeditions next year?"

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Ah. ——...Umm.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...Could I have a moment of your time?
(*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...What if next year, another Umamusume 
becomes unable to run? ...Because of me.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...I have to tell them.

It happened on the way back after running 
an errand in the neighboring town.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...! Trainer <username>...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: What about <chrname>?
choice_data_list:
To the academy. You're heading back there 
too, right, Satake-san?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: "...Ah, yeah. That's true......."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: "...Trainer <username>. I'm sorry."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Please, let me apologize. Even though I 
was entrusted with your precious 
Umamusume, I allowed her condition to 
deteriorate.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...You must have panicked, too. On that 
day, right after returning home, when <chrname> 
suddenly couldn't run anymore.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: I... was pushing all of you too hard.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Taking on challenges overseas comes with 
immense stress. Long flights, unfamiliar 
lands, and the tension unique to playing 
away from home.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
And to run on such demanding turf, getting 
her body into peak condition should have 
been the top priority above all else.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
More than that, I prioritized pushing you 
all to your limits.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Blinded and carried away by the hope of a 
historic first victory. Even though I was 
the one in charge.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"I prioritized my own dream over your 
future."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...I forced my ego onto you and put you 
all in danger."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Even now, I'm putting my own feelings 
first. Venting my complaints like this 
only puts you in a bind.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Perhaps I was never cut out to be a 
leader in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Maybe it'd be better if I weren't around—
choice_data_list:
Are you planning on quitting, by any 
chance?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...I'm terrified.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...I don't want the dreams to fade from 
your eyes, either.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
At some point, you all began holding joint 
training sessions of your own accord, 
didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"When I saw that, I felt happy from the 
bottom of my heart. Thinking what a 
wonderful team it is."

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
—Even though you can already dream all on 
your own now.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"...These hands have no right to tear it 
down. I'm already just a superfluous relic 
of the past—"

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: ...! No. That would just be running away.
choice_data_list: Then please look straight at us!

text_block_list.text:
I grab Mei Satake's hand and take off 
running.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Trainer <username>...!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Want to go for one more? Satono.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: "...I'll go. I can do this!!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Cafe. I borrowed some nail strengthener 
from Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ! ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
We're starting core training now! Anyone 
who wants to join, head over to this 
floor!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! Sirius-senpai! Let's have a contest 
to see who can hold a plank the longest!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I refuse.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Is it because you'll lose death?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Wait! Whoa, whoa, hold on, you two~!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: This is...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Satake-san! Thanks for your hard work! 
Did you come to watch our training!?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...! Satake-san...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I look forward to working with you at 
next year's Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, 
too...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Me too! Me too! I'm definitely making the 
national team, so look forward to it, 
yeees!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: Y-You guys... However, I—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
"The kind of person who burdened you, 
prioritizing victory at the Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe over your future..."

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That's why you were able to put up a 
decent fight, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Everyone knew. Just how obsessed you were 
with the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I jumped onto this project fully aware of 
that, because I want to win with you.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...And because we believed we could win 
next time, we're still standing right here 
today."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Me too! I admit there was a moment after 
returning to Japan where my condition 
dropped. But that was simply proof of my 
own weakness."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"That's why we're preparing now, so it 
won't happen again next year!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"I believe that is precisely the meaning 
behind continuing this project over the 
long term."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Satake-san. You once said that this 
project 'should be able to give a push to 
every Umamusume who dreamed of being the 
best in the world.'

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I am... having a dream.

She reached out to me. Back when I was 
feeling inferior to the brilliance around 
me and on the verge of giving up.
choice_data_list:
"Only those who never give up can rise to 
the challenge."

text_block_list.text:
—This time, I'll try passing on to her the 
feelings that were given to me back then.
choice_data_list:
Won't you chase the world's greatest dream 
with us?

Won't you chase the world's greatest dream 
with us?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Mei.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
The ones who created this project were 
neither Symboli nor Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I joined the project you're in charge of.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Because you were our leader, we had this 
year's Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, and we 
have where we are today.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Then the only one I can build the future 
with is you. ...Am I wrong?

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...So you're telling me to create the kind 
of future only I can make, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Haha. To think you'd go that far for 
me...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: ...Mmh! Mei! So this is where you were!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Next year! Even though there was talk of 
international participants for the planned 
'Representative Exchange Match'!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, Yayoi. You're right...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone, let's talk about next year. 
Let me tell you about what comes next.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Next year, too... I want to aim for the 
world together with all of you.

—It was the very same wish shared by 
everyone in Project L'Arc.
